scope: rational sections over Q(tau), not rational points at specialized tau
assumptions: C and D are nonzero rational numbers

nonsquare_C_fixed_sections.finite: s=0, q=+/- C*e*sqrt(-3D), when -3D is square

affine_section_criterion: C is square or -3D is square
projective_section_criterion: C or D or -3D is square
proof_dependencies: non-CM geometric endomorphism ring is Z
nonconstant pointed genus-one morphisms induce nonzero Jacobian homomorphisms
smooth projective curve extension and quadratic Galois descent

references.author: J. S. Milne
references.title: Elliptic Curves, second edition
references.source: World Scientific, 2021, Chapter II, Section 1, Proposition 1.5
